_comment: Vitals configuration (Documentation/Vitals_Design.md section 6). The single place for the
colour rule, the vitals everyone has and their default ranges, the icon set and the limits.
How it is used: the file is compiled into the server as its defaults. To change values without
rebuilding, set VITALS_CONFIG to a copy of this file (the LAN compose file already mounts this
folder) and restart care-api. A file that fails the checks stops the server at start-up with the
reason, so a typo can't silently change colours.
Colours: inside the range = GREEN; outside by up to yellow_margin_pct percent of the bound that
was crossed = YELLOW; further out = RED. A doctor can change both the range and the margin for
one patient in the app; those per-patient values are stored in the database and win over this file.
Ratio vitals: a vital may also have a "ratio" rule. Urine is coloured by urine output as a percentage of
water intake: green_min_pct or more = GREEN; from yellow_min_pct up to that = YELLOW; less = RED.
A reading with both a range and a ratio takes the worse colour of the two.
Time: a reading may be entered for a time up to limits.backdate_hours ago; it can never be edited afterwards.
The default ranges are general adult starting points for a trial, not clinical advice.

home._comment: The vitals block on the Home screen: tiles per row and rows. The last tile is always More.
